title: More than 100,000 El Paso residents left with little to no water after main break
summary: Officials in Texas city issued boil water notice and set up water distribution centers after main line break on Saturday More than 100,000 residents in the Texas border city of El Paso were left with little to no water after a main break over the weekend, and it was expected to take till midweek for operations to return to normal, officials said. The break in the 36-inch water main line happened late Saturday night in El Paso, which has a population of about 700,000, officials said. Gilbert Trejo, an official with El Paso Water, called it “an event of unprecedented proportion”. He said the break was made even more impactful because of “the way the pipeline itself was designed along with how different connections of smaller lines were made to it.” Continue reading...

title: Average asking rents fell to just over $2K in December — their lowest in more than 2 years
summary: Asking rents in Canada fell 2.3 per cent year-over-year in December to an average of $2,060, marking a full calendar year of declines as prices reached their lowest level in 30 months.
